title: pqtls-lab connection metrics record
description: One JSON object per line of a .jsonl results file. Produced by pqtls-client and pqtls-server; see include/pqtls/metrics.hpp.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this record shape.

tls_version.description: Empty when the handshake did not complete. This project negotiates TLS 1.3 only, so any other value in a successful record indicates a policy failure.

negotiated_group.description: The TLS group actually agreed, as reported by OpenSSL. Case follows OpenSSL's canonical spelling, which is lower case for classical groups and mixed case for the hybrids.

authentication.description: How the peer authenticated. Distinct from negotiated_group: this is the signature, not the key exchange.

pq_key_establishment.description: True when the NEGOTIATED group provides post-quantum key establishment. Derived from negotiated_group, never from requested_profile.

hybrid_key_establishment.description: True when the negotiated group combines a classical ECDH share with an ML-KEM share.

pq_authentication.description: True only when the peer authenticated with a post-quantum signature. A hybrid key exchange with an ECDSA certificate is FALSE here.

allOf.description: A successful connection must name the TLS version and group it negotiated.
A successful record must not carry an error category.
A hybrid key establishment is by definition also a post-quantum key establishment.
